_comment2: Finds songs duplicated across different top-level artist folders.

folders._comment: organized: your sorted music root folder
folders._comment2: reports: where CSV reports and logs are saved
folders._comment3: holding: where removed duplicate files are moved to (not deleted)

matching._comment2: fp_similarity_threshold: 0-100. How similar two fingerprints must be.
matching._comment3: filename_fallback: also check metadata tags and exact filename matches
matching._comment4: duration_tolerance_seconds: max duration difference to still consider a match
matching._comment5: fuzzy_enabled: use fuzzy matching for artist/title tags
matching._comment6: fuzzy_threshold: 0-100. How similar two tags must be. 88 recommended.

performance._comment: max_threads: parallel threads for metadata scanning. 0 = auto

fingerprint._comment: fpcalc_path: path to fpcalc.exe, or just 'fpcalc' if in your PATH
fingerprint._comment2: Fingerprint cache is stored in the shared music_cache.db (fp_cache table). No separate file needed.
fingerprint._comment3: min_fp_length: fingerprints shorter than this are considered invalid
fingerprint._comment4: lsh_bands: LSH bands for candidate detection
